hypotheses.statement: A world of eight Booleans exists whose enumeration gives the stated aggregates (model access 32, 32, 32, 32, 40, 60; sensor access 32, 32, 32, 32, 32, 42; disagreements 8 and 18; none without execution); this world is constructed to the aggregates and is not the original
In that world the sensor's access is contained in the model's, so the disagreements are the model's extra access
An ordinary Boolean model with the same information agrees on all 1,536 comparisons
The ledger realises the world on a 96-pair sample
The EXPANDED mode leaves some disagreements unexplained by the stipulated hidden condition

targets: a synthetic ledger, its worlds and the registries of duties, guarantees and governance principles

instrument_conditions.note: an independent verification model built to the stated aggregates; not a reproduction of the manuscript

reproduction.world: xzr.teoo.lawledger on xzr.teoo.lawworld (own world and a world built to the stated R16 aggregates); registries in xzr.teoo.mheg

R401.criterion: the enumeration equals the stated aggregates (by construction)
R401.reading: the match is by construction: it shows that the stated aggregates are jointly realisable by a nested eight-Boolean world, not that this is the manuscript's world

R402.criterion: sensor access contained in model access

R403.reading: met: no predictive advantage of the ledger or its vocabulary over an ordinary Boolean model with the same information
